about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Fifth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant unto us, O Lord, who are filled with the strength of the heavenly table, both to desire what is right and to receive what we desire. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
